description:
Configure the store for privacy compliance. 

1. Go to Stores > Configuration > General > Web > Default Cookie Settings. Set 'Cookie Restriction Mode' to Yes, 'Cookie Lifetime' to 86400, and 'Use HTTP Only' to Yes. 

2. Create a new CMS Page (Content > Pages) titled 'Privacy Policy 2026' with URL Key 'privacy-policy-2026'. Ensure it is Enabled and has some content. 

3. Update the footer copyright (Content > Design > Configuration > Edit Default Store View > Footer) to: 'Copyright © 2026 Acme Corp. All Rights Reserved.' 

If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
